scenes.sense: Liquid flowing in a continuing trickle
scenes.description: An adult on a hot summer day with sweat streaming in long drops down the forehead and neck, holding a plain hand fan. Emphasize continuous flowing sweat rather than a few isolated droplets.
One person continues talking at a meeting table while two listeners prop their faces on their hands.
An alert person lounges loosely across a sofa beside a remote, with laundry and dishes left in the background.
